name: team-workflow
description: For Claude Code and agy (Antigravity): shared project memory read at every session, on-demand teams of 20 core specialist agents plus language, framework, quality and other packs (all of Everything Claude Code's agents), led by the main session, that talk to each other to debug and verify each other's work; a searchable library of ECC's skills, commands and rules, and an end-of-task report that asks before applying changes.
